turns.user: My grandmother is 67. Can she ride the 100E without paying?
turns.agent:
Yes. At age 67, your grandmother can ride the 100E free of charge; BKK says people over 65 may do so upon presentation of proof of age. She should carry an accepted age-identifying document and be ready to show it if requested.

The rule and supporting documents are stated on BKK’s Airport Express information page. My fare notes are a snapshot dated 5 November 2026; this specific 100E eligibility point was cross-checked on 6 November 2026. I’m an independent demo, not affiliated with BKK, so check the official page for current details.

turns.user: She can show official proof of age.
